note: Reference text for the NON-OCR extraction path. Authored or hand-transcribed -- never taken from the PDF's own text layer, which is both circular and, on Arabic, wrong.
why_not_the_text_layer: Circular: PyMuPDF reading the text layer is what we are trying to measure.

Wrong on Arabic: public Arabic PDFs here store presentation forms in visual order and reverse digit runs (wipo_eg088ar_1.pdf page 3 renders 2023 and extracts 3202), so such a reference would penalise the pipeline for repairing the damage correctly.
